name: localfix
description: LocalFix: a local services reverse-bidding marketplace (MERN). CS 313 Web Engineering group project.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
